sample_unit: paired treatment appropriateness scores (240 patient scenarios)

links.outcome: Agreement between ChatGPT-4o and AAOS appropriate use criteria for distal radius fracture treatments
links.effect: Agreement ranged from 99.17% (immobilization without reduction) and 90.42% (volar locking plates) to 15% (dorsal plating); mean error ranged 0.6 to -2.9; ChatGPT-4o favored conservative approaches.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o does not consistently align with the appropriate use criteria in determining appropriate management of distal radius fractures.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy of ChatGPT-4o against AAOS Appropriate Use Criteria on simulated clinical scenarios for distal radius fractures without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
